question: Does a public benchmark with overlapping successive regulatory revisions and time-stamped queries already exist, making the planned benchmark construction redundant?
description: The contribution includes constructing a benchmark of regulatory documents with overlapping revisions and time-stamped queries. Prior et al. (arxiv:2605.23497) present 312 expert-validated time-sensitive statutory QA pairs; TIQ (doi:10.1145/3589335.3651895) is a temporal QA benchmark with implicit time constraints. It is unclear whether these provide version-level overlaps and per-passage version timestamps sufficient to test the ranking mechanism.
rationale: Determines whether the benchmark contribution is novel or merely a reuse of an existing resource.
